<solar/>Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb is replaced with a Healing Turret. Consuming a <solar/>Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of the user.

Healing Turret information:
• Lasts 15 seconds and has 100? HP
• Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters
• Healing Seekers apply <solar/>Cure x1 and <solar/>Restoration x1 for <pve 4 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds in a 7.5 meter radius (strength of both buffs is increased to x2 with <solar/>Touch of Flame equipped)

Some forms (genuinely no idea) of healing to allies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy at their position. 10 second cooldown between activations.

<link Note [https://www.bungie.net/7/en/News/article/twid_06_27_2024] />: Orb of Power Generation will soon be disabled in the Crucible.
